title: Tideglass AI development execution program

logical_delivery_roles.responsibility: Own product/economy decisions, task dispatch, integration, scope and release evidence. Write progression/content data and operating plans; integrate every accepted contribution.
Implement numeric core, purchases, milestones, prestige, synergies, online/offline timeline, automation, challenge/event runtime and simulation.
Implement native client, onboarding, forecasts, daily interfaces, settings, accessibility, cosmetic/pass UX and distribution packaging. Initial content registry is an integration contribution.
Implement durable persistence, cloud recovery, identity, verified entitlement services, ad/free ledger, telemetry, operations and native SDK adapters.
Produce and integrate harbor/producer art, animations, UI assets, cosmetics, narrative and audio assets; maintain asset provenance and completeness.
Own independent regressions, device/fault/accessibility checks, scope audits, cohort measurement, review evidence and release readiness. Never approve an unrun device or store check.

execution_policy.batch_dependencies: finish-to-start acceptance gates; tasks within a batch may proceed against reviewed contracts
execution_policy.old_dependencies: acceptance prerequisites only, copied from v1_backlog.json
execution_policy.acceptance_rule: Non-author review, relevant checks and integrated evidence are required. External gates cannot pass from stubs or synthetic participants.
execution_policy.calendar: Human 36-week plan is historical; AI throughput is measured after accepted slices. D30/store/device/14-day coverage remain real constraints.
execution_policy.persistence: Role charters and task/evidence files persist. Session agents are not autonomous background workers.

batches.title: Create the execution baseline
steps: Freeze the source scope and register six AI delivery roles with file ownership.
Export reference economy fixtures, register all launch content and validate a versioned save-envelope contract in three independent lanes.
Cross-review these artifacts, run validators and reconcile scope in both directions. Mark only these development artifacts complete.
acceptance: Reference exports are repeatable; content inventory is structurally complete but unfinished assets remain flagged; invalid save cases are rejected.

batches.title: Lock release decisions and native candidate criteria
steps: Preserve mobile-first iOS/Android scope, English launch, guest offline play and the full content inventory; replace human staffing assignments with AI role ownership.
Specify audience, territories, minimum OS/device matrix, numeric precision questions and provider-selection criteria; record unresolved decisions with owners.
Client implements reviewable first-purchase, Rechart, return and recovery flow prototypes; art owner supplies a reusable visual sample.
QA lists real-device scenarios and tester recruitment needs; director budgets tool usage, services, hardware, asset licensing and external testing without assuming six payroll positions.
acceptance: Four critical flows are reviewable; no public desktop, multiplayer or extra prestige tier enters scope; native proof criteria and remaining account/device needs are explicit.
external_dependencies: Product owner supplies unavailable audience/territory/budget constraints before dependent service enrollment or spending.

batches.title: Qualify and pin the native production stack
steps: Inspect host toolchains and repair the local Android Java/build prerequisite; verify changes without altering unrelated projects.
Shortlist supported engines/runtimes using current official documentation. Build an actual iOS and Android purchase/reset screen with headless economic boundary.
Prove sandbox purchase/restore, optional ad plus free fallback and cloud revision behavior using candidate adapters. Stub demos cannot satisfy this gate.
Select the stack from evidence, pin engine/SDK/dependency versions and licenses, create repeatable builds and map conceptual paths to actual project modules.
acceptance: Both native builds launch; sandbox integration evidence exists; reproducible headless/core test entry point runs. An unproven required adapter prevents stack lock.
external_dependencies: Native account/test-product configuration, signing credentials and available target devices; no real purchases required.

batches.title: Implement production arithmetic and core state
steps: Define numeric precision, currency accounting units, rounding and exact prestige boundaries before porting formulas.
Implement five producers, unlocks, bulk/max/milestone purchase commands, milestones, lifetime earnings and atomic Rechart transitions.
Version economic/content schemas and pin configurations to state; reject invalid or unsupported versions.
Compare bounded cases with the reference fixtures and add independent extreme-value/property checks; keep all reward logic outside presentation.
acceptance: No unaffordable purchase or repeated entitlement; reset preview agrees with transition; numeric error cannot cross a discrete award boundary.

batches.title: Implement durable local state
steps: Implement crash-safe writes, checksums, rolling recovery copies, migration and export/import against the reviewed envelope contract.
Commit economic actions and pending operation identities together; retry/recovery never grants a transaction twice.
QA injects interruption/corruption at every commit stage and ports production conformance fixtures, including rapid reset and version changes.
acceptance: Fresh, upgraded and corrupted saves recover to valid states; interrupted reward/reset histories do not duplicate or erase committed progression.

batches.title: Build client shell and complete progression specifications
steps: Implement responsive harbor, producer controls, wallet/rate/retained-progress displays and settings over the core API.
Director authors all six chapter goals and the ending, challenge unlocks and required versus optional Note sinks.
Art owner delivers reusable scene/icon/type components with scales, states and reduced-motion behavior; externalize all text.
acceptance: Playable shell on small phone and tablet; six-chapter goal specification exists; no duplicate economy arithmetic in UI.

batches.title: Integrate the representative first session
steps: Gameplay implements 10-Chart autobuy, 25-Chart synergies and baseline offline replay for the systems present in this slice only; full daily timers and bonuses arrive in B08.
Client teaches buying/Rechart/automation, displays marginal network output and conditional forecasts, and shows the offline return breakdown.
Platform adds optional account recovery with revision checks and explicit divergent-branch choice; never sum divergent wallets or offline intervals.
Art owner integrates a representative harbor, all five base silhouettes and one milestone sequence; exercise the whole path on both targets.
acceptance: Gifted Skiff to five tiers, Rechart, autobuy, synergy, close/return and recovery is playable; forecasts disclose assumptions.
external_dependencies: Configured test cloud service and native targets.

batches.title: Validate the slice with people and faults
steps: Director prepares a neutral moderator script and recruits at least 15 new testers through authorized channels.
Observe first-session completion and reset/offline understanding; report non-finishers as well as pacing among finishers.
QA reproduces critical misunderstandings and device/save/resume defects; assigned engineers repair and rerun affected checks.
Accept the slice only with evidence; use accepted task throughput to produce the first AI delivery forecast.
acceptance: At least 80% explanation target is assessed with individual failures; integrated device checks pass; no inference from bots is called human comprehension.
external_dependencies: Real recruited testers and their consent; agents can prepare and analyze, not impersonate participants.

batches.title: Implement the full daily timeline
steps: Implement Focus and Survey timers, offline full/tail envelope, bonus expiration and account-day boundaries on one ordered timeline.
Implement seeded contracts, frozen goals, rerolls, claim identities and 21-slot missed-day backlog.
Implement player purchase priorities, 100-Chart conditional reset plans, one free slot and Note-priced extras.
Client implements calibration with equal accessible completion, queued Focus, daily UI, text/notation/audio/motion controls and opt-in quiet-hour notifications.
acceptance: 2/8/24-hour behavior and 72-hour maximum absence envelope match the blueprint; same policy gives matching discrete outcomes online/offline.

batches.title: Implement identity and claim services
steps: Implement guest linking, account recovery/deletion/export and conflict selection with preserved recovery branches.
Separate trusted commercial ownership from local progression and cached display flags; introduce idempotent claim and receipt storage.
Specify Support allowance and pass-XP reconciliation; handle retries, offline claims and concurrent devices without duplicate grants.
acceptance: Guest economy works without login; confirmed ownership is recoverable; interrupted grants resume once; divergent progression is never silently merged.

batches.title: Complete the integrated alpha
steps: Finish chapter/challenge objectives, unlocks, copy requirements and rewards against passive and active routes.
Art owner produces all 25 producer presentations and daily UI states through the approved reusable pipeline.
QA runs combined visit schedules, absences, clock changes, reset/day collisions and bonus queues; engineers resolve failures.
acceptance: Every core loop works in one build; 25 presentations are actually integrated; exact/approximate numerical differences are reported.

batches.title: Implement isolated challenge and season runtimes
steps: Implement reusable constrained-fleet, synergy-priority and automation-planning scenarios with independent state.
Implement Season 1 lifecycle, pinned coefficients, start/end/archive transitions and one selected pass.
Ensure main automation continues while playing optional content; no main/paid power imports or economic exports; test exit/restart/offline boundaries.
acceptance: New and veteran players start equally in the event; live/archive transitions preserve legitimate progress and cannot mint economic rewards.

batches.title: Produce the complete campaign and launch assets
steps: Author and integrate all six chapters/ending, twelve dossiers, twelve calibration patterns, eighteen main archive entries and Season 1 copy.
Produce initial harbor plus six restored states, all 36 cosmetics and required UI states; maintain provenance, atlas/memory budgets and actual files.
Populate 30 free pass slots and ten premium cosmetics, soundtrack delivery, audio cues/volume controls and support material.
Validate identifiers and reward relationships, inspect actual screens and asset variants; planned placeholders never pass release mode.
acceptance: All fixed quantities are integrated and reachable; supporter bundle reuses its specified cosmetics; none of these assets changes production.
external_dependencies: A licensed audio source or suitable audio-production capability if the available tools cannot deliver finished audio.

batches.title: Implement cosmetic commerce and equal free rewards
steps: Client implements previews, localized prices, ownership, restoration, pass selection and archived continuation.
Platform verifies native transactions, grants once, acknowledges/completes, restores and reconciles pending, duplicate, cancelled, interrupted and revoked purchases.
Integrate optional ads through the same six-token allowance as the free briefing; refusal/no-fill leaves the free route available.
Test Support buffs, queues and offline claims against the shared ledger; cosmetics and paid pass never add production power.
acceptance: Real sandbox purchase/restore/fault evidence on both stores; no fake receipt or stub ad adapter satisfies acceptance.
external_dependencies: Store sandbox products, test accounts and approved SDK configuration.

batches.title: Certify complete content and commercial boundaries
steps: Traverse all content/reward IDs from realistic entry states and check campaign ending independently of optional completion.
Run accelerated complete-season and archived paid-pass paths; separately retain the later real-calendar gate.

Check no ad/cosmetic/event export increases core power beyond the equal free allowance. Run validate_content_manifest.py --content-gate: all gameplay content/assets must be verified; support documents and help/support UI receive final acceptance before B22.
acceptance: All content and rewards are reachable with no placeholder; free pass completion requires no purchase; asset and reward counts match scope.

batches.title: Optimize presentation and device performance
steps: Measure frame time, startup, 24-hour replay, battery and thermal behavior on the named minimum/midrange hardware.
Optimize/chunk long replays without discarding owed time; handle large text, color/audio/motion independence and target inputs.
Run pseudolocalization, integrate final audio and remove placeholders; create screenshots/icon/footage from actual builds.
acceptance: Roadmap performance/return budgets are measured; critical flows remain accessible; store images represent actual play.
external_dependencies: Physical minimum/midrange iOS and Android devices; simulators cannot establish thermal/battery results.

batches.title: Verify privacy and operating services
steps: Compare actual SDK/network behavior with data inventory, consent and deletion/export flows.
Implement trustworthy economy/session events, diagnostic exports, entitlement dashboards and version-compatible feature controls.
Exercise backups, service failure, recovery and minimal-data support tooling; preserve cached offline play.
acceptance: Declarations match actual collection; consent refusal and outages preserve promised access; metrics and alerts reflect known injected events.
external_dependencies: Configured staging services and product-owner decisions on required platform declarations.

batches.title: Run long-horizon and release-fault regression
steps: Director/gameplay compare 30/90-day trajectories across purchase/reset/visit/bonus policies, Notes and content coverage.
QA runs minimum-device, storage/network interruption, migration and commerce retry/refund/ad faults.

Before enrollment, preregister the primary retention/satisfaction outcome, observation duration, exclusions and analysis. Specify descriptive precision; for any causal experiment separately set minimum detectable effect, power and allocation/sample calculation. Freeze beta configuration after faults are resolved; recruit before observation.
acceptance: No known save-loss or entitlement blocker; full trajectory bonus parity is assessed; 1,750-Note optional collection is not a hidden main-ending requirement.

batches.title: Enroll the real measurement cohort
steps: Prepare distribution, consent, recruitment and baseline version records; use only authorized external outreach and deployment.

Enroll the principal D30 cohort in a documented window; target 500 eligible starts and 10,000 sessions across the study. These planning counts do not guarantee causal power; do not run an underpowered experiment or substitute them for a power calculation.
Record denominator, predeclared exclusions, acquisition source and missing telemetry; start real seasonal observation.
acceptance: Actual participants are enrolled and baseline is frozen; sample shortfall is reported rather than replaced with simulated users.
external_dependencies: Real people, enrollment funding/access and authorized test distribution.

batches.title: Operate testing and correct observed defects
steps: Engineers resolve reproducible core, client and service findings; art owner fixes readability without expanding scope.
Operate support and staged access; rehearse season archive, paid continuation, migration, entitlement replay and compatible forward repair.
Observe an actual 28-day season and mature day-30 windows. A material experience change creates a separately analyzed cohort and may restart the observation requirement.
acceptance: Real calendar gates mature; controlled fixes have replay evidence; final cohort is not mixed across unrecorded balance changes.
external_dependencies: At least the full D30 observation opportunity; physical devices and testers remain necessary.

batches.title: Decide product readiness from mature evidence
steps: Compute mature D1/D7/D30 with uncertainty and observability limits; compare provisional 35/15/7% review targets.
Assess campaign pacing, comprehension, strategy variety, bonuses, satisfaction, pressure and operating cost.
QA cross-checks calculations; record ship, extend or revise decision. Retention targets cannot waive correctness, ownership or fairness failures.
acceptance: Results are based on real eligible participants; non-finishers and missing data are visible; every required review signal has evidence.

batches.title: Freeze and prove the release candidate
steps: Review all hard gates, freeze candidate/config/content and list only acceptable minor issues with owners.
Engineers tag compatible builds, exercise signing/install/update/distribution and prepare forward-fix and feature-disable paths.

Art/client finish accurate store/help/credits materials; platform finishes privacy/support/operations documents and rehearses recovery. Director prepares the initial Season 2 brief before launch; all eight support-content records and help/support UI must be verified before B22.
acceptance: Candidate passes exact-version regression; no normal-progression/accessibility/purchased-content blocker; listings match shipped build.
external_dependencies: Distribution signing/account access and reviewable products.

batches.title: Submit and launch under explicit release authority
steps: Run the full content --release check and independently review the evidence pack; recheck current platform rules from official sources. Program --release is the later final-completion check, after actual launch support.
Prepare review notes, working products/URLs and restore instructions; submit after the concrete build/listing is authorized.
Resolve review findings, stage rollout where supported and assign 14-day coverage/incident escalation; stop rollout if save or entitlement integrity fails.
acceptance: Both stores accept the actual build; rollout is authorized and observed; account actions and postlaunch owner are explicit.
external_dependencies: Store review duration, account owner authority and explicit authorization for public release.

batches.title: Complete launch support and v1 handoff
steps: Inspect crash/resume/save/entitlement trends daily for 14 days after actual launch using a named operating arrangement.
Route incidents to owning agents; reproduce, repair, independently review and release narrowly scoped fixes with appropriate authorization.
Close incident follow-through, record actual shipped scope/gates/minor issues and ongoing service costs; finalize the prelaunch Season 2 brief using observed issues without expanding v1.
acceptance: Fourteen days of real operating coverage and incident evidence exist; ongoing ownership is handed off.
external_dependencies: Elapsed time and an active human/scheduled operating arrangement; session agents are not an always-on service.
